system.description:
You must have «Resurrection» in order to acquire this skill. You may immediately use «Resurrection» with [Range: 4 Sq.] In addition, the target of «Resurrection» is made to [Teleport (forced)] to the square you are in.

(SR2): When you use this skill, the target of «Resurrection» also removes all Bad Statuses currently affecting them.

A magic that not only brings back the souls of dying bodies, but also brings the bodies of allies back to you by offering prayers to return to the underworld.
